verdict.rationale: Convex defines automations (crons, scheduler-driven background workflows) as TypeScript functions that the CLI pushes to deployments as "new versions", and the pricing page lists preview deployments, which offer a first-party place to review changes before production. Evidence for this story is a single unexplained line item plus deploy-flow wording; nothing documents automation version history, review workflows, or rollback. Missing for 10: documented version history for functions/crons/workflows, a documented review or approval flow beyond a bare 'preview deployments' mention, any rollback or revert-to-prior-deployment capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
